fields.label: Pull request endpoints
fields.helpText: One HTTP(S) endpoint per line. Endpoints can be native APIs, internal exports, webhooks, or JSON/text snapshots.

fields.label: Bearer token env var names
fields.helpText: Enter variable names only, such as GITHUB_TOKEN. Put the actual GITHUB_TOKEN=... secret in the local .env file; the first configured variable with a value is sent as Authorization: Bearer ...

fields.label: Context notes
fields.placeholder: Focus on PRs waiting on me, stale PRs, failing CI, requested changes, and risky large diffs.
fields.helpText: Optional instructions, priorities, account names, or pasted context to include in every run.

fields.label: Publish report to Item Bus
fields.helpText: When enabled, each run publishes the report as a dev.pr-review-digest item.
